$comment: Golden test vectors for Yhtua's crypto formats, pinned from the shipping implementation (v2.8.2). Byte-exact compatibility contract for every implementation (Rust crate, mobile bridge, device self-test). Never regenerate to make a failing test pass — a mismatch IS a format break. Synthetic key and secrets only. Kept in sync with src-tauri/src/crypto.rs by the golden_vectors_match_shared_fixture_file test.

vectors.description: Local secret: 'YHL2' || nonce(12) || AES-256-GCM(ct||tag), AAD 'yhtua-local-secret-v2', keychain key
Portable backup: 'YHP2' || salt(16) || nonce(12) || AES-256-GCM(ct||tag), AAD 'yhtua-password-backup-v2', Argon2id key
Pre-2.8 local secret: nonce(12) || AES-256-GCM(ct||tag), empty AAD. Read-compatible only
Pre-2.8 backup: salt(16) || nonce(12) || AES-256-GCM(ct||tag), empty AAD, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 600k. Read-compatible only

rejection_vectors.description: Golden YHL2 truncated to magic+nonce+tag-1 bytes; every consumer must reject as malformed
Golden YHL2 with the last auth-tag byte flipped; must fail authentication
Golden YHL2 with the first magic byte flipped; routes to the legacy layout and must fail authentication there
Golden YHP2 truncated to 20 bytes (magic intact); every consumer must reject as malformed
Golden YHP2 with the last auth-tag byte flipped; must fail authentication
Golden YHP2 with the first magic byte flipped; routes to the legacy layout and must fail authentication there
Golden legacy-local with the last auth-tag byte flipped; must fail authentication
Golden legacy-password with the last auth-tag byte flipped; must fail authentication
